procedural_matters: FRA10 was represented by Brieuc Drogou.
Race Committee was represented by Anastasia Weinberger.
Max v. Buddenbrock was a witness for the Race Committee.
Max v. Buddenbrock presented video evidence.
facts: During Race 7 of the Vaurien World Championship, wind was 10 knots with choppy waves.
The preparatory flag for Race 7 was black flag.
No adjustment was made to thepin end during the starting sequence.
FRA 10 was on starboard tack atthe pin end of the starting line.
FRA 10 was observed in thetriangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during thelast 10 seconds of the starting sequence.
FRA 10 started the race andfinished in first position.
conclusions: There was neither an improperaction nor an improper mission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirementsfor redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
